description: Defines template struct 'common_policy_traits' for managing container slot initialization, destruction, transfer, and element access, with support for type traits and conditional memcpy optimization.

classes.name: common_policy_traits
classes.description: Template struct providing policies for slot management in containers, including construction, destruction, transfer, and element access.
